uncertainties.meaning: Whether the centre's stock at 4:00 PM Tuesday (after Monday and Tuesday collections) is at least 150 units to dispatch the full shipment. The centre starts with 40 units, collects 12 units/hour for 8 hours on Monday (96 units) and 7 hours on Tuesday (84 units) before 4:00 PM, totalling 220 units. So it has enough. No uncertainty.

Whether the centre's stock at 4:00 PM Thursday (after Wednesday and Thursday collections) is at least 150 units. After Tuesday dispatch, centre stock is 220 - 150 = 70 units. Wednesday collection: 12 units/hour for 8 hours = 96 units, total 166 units. Thursday collection before 4:00 PM: 7 hours = 84 units, total 250 units. So it has enough. No uncertainty.
The shipment dispatched at 4:00 PM Tuesday arrives at the hospital at 7:00 PM Tuesday, which is before Friday noon. So it is received. No uncertainty.
The shipment dispatched at 4:00 PM Thursday arrives at 7:00 PM Thursday, before Friday noon. So it is received. No uncertainty.
The total units the hospital holds at Friday noon: initial 15 + Tuesday shipment 150 + Thursday shipment 150 = 315 units. No uncertainty.
